screen.coverage_semantics_note: Per-sampled-wallet probes succeeded, but only 8 of 19 eligible holder wallets were sampled; the report's aggregate funding complete flag does not represent complete roster coverage.

real_sol_curve_reserve.interpretation: Rapid reserve expansion, material pullback, and recovery. Reserve is not price return or PnL.

initial_inventory_relay.confirmed_method: Successful parsed TransferChecked instructions; recipient token-account owners confirmed from transaction post-token balances; each source has an exact earlier frozen curve-buy match.

entry_holder_concentration.interpretation: Sampled retention is concentration evidence only. At entry, no single confirmed narrow launch-window funding source linked the three largest retained wallets.

cross_launch_cohort.interpretation: Strong repeated address cohort between adjacent Cfiyy and DgT6 tapes; low Cvy overlap. Exact-address association does not prove common control or fake volume.

policy_gaps_supported_by_this_case: The entry funding completeness flag stayed true despite a 8-of-19 holder funding sample.
The 10-minute exact-address history expired before the repeated Cfiyy cohort returned; checkpoint restore also clears that history.
The detector receipt ring was under its 256 cap at DgT6 entry but later saturated.
The current relationship input captures curve buyers and bounded System Program SOL transfers, but not the initial SPL inventory relay path.
recommended_research_only_followups: Add verified mint-specific SPL transfer custody edges with recipient-owner attribution and balance reconciliation.
Persist cross-launch exact-address cohorts for measured longer horizons and report age coverage.
Separate per-wallet funding probe success from complete holder-roster coverage and from source-profile candidate completeness.
Measure false positives on ordinary launches before any admission-policy or threshold change.
limits: Frozen DgT6 observation sample ends at 23:54:27 UTC and is not a full lifecycle receipt graph.
